key_concepts: Balanced forces do not change an object's state of motion
Acceleration is due to an external net force
An object changes speed, direction, or both when forces are unbalanced
An accelerometer's cork moves in the direction of force and acceleration
For a constant force, acceleration decreases as mass increases
Mass and acceleration are inversely proportional when net force is constant
Mass multiplied by acceleration equals net force
For constant mass, acceleration increases as net force increases
Net force and acceleration are directly proportional when mass is constant
Force divided by acceleration equals mass
Newton's second law can be represented mathematically as F = ma
